name: AI Companion

install_consent_messages.en: The AI Companion uses host networking so it can reach Crow and your local models on this machine. That also lets it reach every service on this machine that listens only on 127.0.0.1. Its own web page listens on 127.0.0.1 by default (COMPANION_BIND_HOST), and Crow serves it to your tailnet over HTTPS. It mounts Crow's database read-only (every table, including saved provider keys) and is given Crow's local MCP token. It does not mount your other extensions' folders.
install_consent_messages.es: El AI Companion usa la red del host para poder llegar a Crow y a tus modelos locales en esta máquina. Eso también le permite llegar a todos los servicios de esta máquina que escuchan solo en 127.0.0.1. Su propia página web escucha por defecto en 127.0.0.1 (COMPANION_BIND_HOST), y Crow la sirve a tu tailnet por HTTPS. Monta en solo lectura la base de datos de Crow (todas las tablas, incluidas las claves de proveedores guardadas) y recibe el token MCP local de Crow. No monta las carpetas de tus demás extensiones.

description: Voice-interactive AI companion with animated Live2D avatar. Powered by Open-LLM-VTuber with Crow's BYOAI profiles.
author: Crow

env_vars.name: COMPANION_AVATAR
env_vars.description: Live2D avatar model (bundled: mao_pro, shizuku, hiyori, epsilon, hibiki, mark, simple; eikanya: senko, xinnong, dafeng, aijier, shengluyisi, biaoqiang, aersasi, ak12, an94)

env_vars.name: EIKANYA_MODELS_DIR
env_vars.description: Path to downloaded Eikanya Live2D models directory

env_vars.name: COMPANION_PERSONA
env_vars.description: Persona prompt for the companion's personality
env_vars.default: You are Crow, an AI companion and assistant. You are helpful, curious, and have a dry wit. Keep responses conversational and concise since they will be spoken aloud.

notes: Uses Crow's AI Profiles for LLM inference (configure in Settings > AI Profiles). Voice recognition (ASR) runs locally on CPU. Text-to-speech uses Microsoft Edge TTS (free, requires internet). Access via Tailscale HTTPS for microphone support.
